reachableSurface: Metro, Tailwind and the shadcn CLI expand glob patterns from this repository's own configuration while building or scaffolding. Ramassa never passes user input to braces. On 2026-10-09 the iOS export source map (4,319 modules) and the admin Vite build contained no braces module.
upstreamStatus: Advisory published 2026-09-18 for braces <= 3.0.3 with no first patched version. The latest release is 3.0.3 (2024-05-21).
removalCondition: Remove when braces publishes a patched release (then add an exact override) or when micromatch, Metro and fast-glob no longer depend on a vulnerable braces.

reachableSurface: The Expo CLI uses node-forge on developer machines for local certificates and update code signing. The shipped app does not include it. On 2026-10-09 the iOS export source map (4,319 modules) and the admin Vite build contained no node-forge module.
upstreamStatus: Advisory published 2026-09-03 for node-forge <= 1.4.0 with no first patched version. The latest release is 1.4.0 (2026-03-24).
removalCondition: Remove when node-forge publishes a patched release (then add an exact override) or when the Expo CLI no longer depends on a vulnerable node-forge.
